extracted.intended_audience: Investigators and administrative staff preparing NIH PHS 398 grant applications (biosketches, modular budgets, research plan attachments)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling NIH PHS 398 application components (biographical sketches, personnel justifications, modular budgets, and required Research Plan attachments) according to form instructions and page limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include NAME, eRA Commons user name, POSITION TITLE, EDUCATION/TRAINING (begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education). Follow the sample Biographical Sketch to complete sections A, B, C, and D. Use this format for every senior/key person and other significant contributors; adhere strictly to the five-page maximum.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement: (investigator summarizes relevant experience and fit for the project).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe relevant experience, specific expertise related to the proposed project, past collaborations with the PD/PI or team, and how you will contribute. Use examples of prior work/publications to support claims of expertise and fit (as shown by included sample personal statements).

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Employment (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Employment: list positions and employment history with dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide chronological positions and appointments (including visiting fellowships, faculty appointments, administrative roles) with years. Include relevant leadership roles and editorial positions where pertinent to qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contribution to Science: narrative describing major contributions with supporting publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each major contribution, give a concise narrative and list selected representative publications (numbered). Use the narrative to link prior work to the proposed research; include examples, impact (e.g., citations), and specific papers that support the statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (Biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support: list ongoing and completed research support, roles, and project descriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish ongoing research support and completed support. For each item include grant number, awarding institute, project title, major goals, role (e.g., PI, Co-Investigator), and grant period/dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal statement and contributions should include supporting publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Include cited publications (with PMID/PMCID/DOI where available) referenced within the Personal Statement and Contribution to Science sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete bibliographic entries for cited works; when appropriate include PMIDs and PMCIDs, and a Complete List of Published Work link (MyBibliography) if available.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Subjects and Clinical Trial designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Subjects: Clinical Trial? Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial? — must be answered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether the proposed project involves human subjects and whether it is a clinical trial and/or an agency-defined Phase III trial. Provide the appropriate checkbox response(s) on the Cover Page Supplement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permission Statement for disclosure of applicant information
rubrics_metrics.description: If this application does not result in an award, is the Government permitted to disclose the title of your proposed project, and the name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the official signing for the applicant organization, to organizations that may be interested in contacting you for further information?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select Yes or No. If 'Yes', the Government may disclose contact details and project title to potential interested organizations. Ensure institutional approval for the chosen response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Is program income anticipated during the periods for which the grant support is requested? — must be answered and, if yes, provide amounts and sources per budget period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Yes, list Budget Period, Anticipated Amount ($), and Source(s) using the provided format. If No, leave section blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC) reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? If yes list registration numbers or indicate that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the project involves hESCs, list specific registry numbers from the NIH registry or check the box stating a registry line will be used. If not, indicate 'No'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents reporting (renewals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inventions and Patents (For renewal applications only): must indicate Yes/No and previously reported status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For renewal applications, declare whether there are inventions/patents and whether they were previously reported; provide details if Yes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution questions
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, provide the name of former principal investigator/program director or former grantee institution when indicating a change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer change-related checkboxes and supply the former PI name or former institution name when required by the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Modular Budget structure and required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Modular Budget: For each Budget Period include A. Direct Costs, B. Indirect Costs, MTDC, Consortium F&A, Total Direct Costs, Funds Requested, Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), Funds Requested, Cognizant Agency and agreement date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete modular budget tables for each budget period (Start/End dates provided). Report 'Direct Cost less Consortium F&A', 'Consortium F&A', 'Total Direct Costs', and 'Total Indirect Costs'. Attach Budget Justifications (Personnel, Consortium, Additional Narrative) and include Cognizant Agency contact and Indirect Cost Rate Agreement Date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel Justification requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: PERSONNEL JUSTIFICATION: Senior/Key Personnel listing with percent effort and person months per year and descriptions of roles and responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each senior/key person provide name, degree/title, role (e.g., PI), percent effort and person-months per year. For collaborators indicate measurable or no measurable effort and describe the specific contributions (e.g., provision of reagents, intellectual input) and letters of support. For other personnel, list staffing, person-months/year, specific skills and duties, and how they contribute to the aims. Justify qualifications, responsibilities, and interaction within the project; indicate how team coherence supports feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required Research Plan attachments and sections (PHS 398 Research Plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please attach applicable sections of the research plan: 1. Introduction to Application (for RESUBMISSION or REVISION only), 2. Specific Aims, 3. Research Strategy*, 4. Progress Report Publication List, 5. Protection of Human Subjects, 6. Inclusion of Women and Minorities, 7. Inclusion of Children, 8. Vertebrate Animals, 9. Select Agent Research, 10. Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan, 11. Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, 12. Letters of Support, 13. Resource Sharing Plan(s), 14. Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and attach each applicable file labeled per the form (e.g., Research_Plan.pdf, HYPOTHESIS_AND_SPECIFIC_AIMS.pdf, Vertebrate_Animals.pdf). Include human subjects protections and inclusion plans when relevant. Provide resource sharing plans and letters of support as separate attachments. For resubmissions include an Introduction describing responses to prior reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction for resubmission or revision
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction to Application (for RESUBMISSION or REVISION only) — explanation of how previously noted reviewer critiques were addressed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe changes made in response to prior reviews, additions of preliminary data, new reagents/models, and how the revisions improve novelty, relevance, feasibility, design, and methodology. Highlight revisions and explain continuity from prior aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing and Appendix inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Resource Sharing Plan(s) and Appendix materials (if applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide statements/files for data sharing, model organism sharing, and other resource plans. Use the Appendix only when explicitly allowed and include any supplementary materials as specified by the program announcement or form instructions.
